purpose: Pinned native C++ coverage collection and report-conversion tools.

configurationRequirements.status: Set to pinned only after provenance and licensing review.
configurationRequirements.role: Must match one requiredArtifactRoles entry exactly.
configurationRequirements.name: Stable human-readable artifact name.
configurationRequirements.version: Exact immutable tool version; wildcards and moving labels are forbidden.
configurationRequirements.url: Immutable HTTPS archive URL from the reviewed publisher.
configurationRequirements.sha256: Exactly 64 hexadecimal characters calculated from the reviewed archive.
configurationRequirements.archiveFileName: Plain .zip or .nupkg file name without directory components.
configurationRequirements.requiredFiles: Non-empty array of objects with archive-relative path and reviewed file SHA-256.
